# Evaluation: antideepfake-mms-300m on In-the-Wild

*Generated by `eval/analyze.py`. Test speakers only, unless marked dev. Brackets are 95%
confidence intervals from resampling whole speakers. Scores are raw (uncalibrated) unless
marked calibrated.*

## Headline (clean audio, test speakers)

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Clips scored | 23,098 (8,694 fake) from 43 speakers |
| EER | 1.9% (1.4% to 2.8%) |
| ROC-AUC | 0.998 (0.995 to 0.999) |
| Fakes caught at 1% false positives | 96.8% (94.8% to 98.1%) |
| Fakes caught at 5% false positives | 99.1% (97.9% to 99.8%) |
| Not assessed (too little sound) | genuine 16.0% (2,752), synthetic 11.3% (1,103) |

## Shortcut check: clip length

Clip duration alone, with no model: AUC 0.624, EER 41.1%. Correlation between score and duration among genuine clips (Spearman): -0.15.

| Duration | Clips | Fake share | EER | AUC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0-2 s | 2,606 | 24.9% | 7.8% | 0.976 |
| 2-4 s | 10,359 | 31.2% | 2.0% | 0.997 |
| 4-8 s | 7,241 | 42.3% | 0.3% | 1.000 |
| 8 s and up | 2,892 | 60.5% | 1.2% | 0.999 |

## Bands (thresholds chosen on dev, applied to test)

Chosen on 4,353 clean dev clips. *Likely synthetic* at raw score 0.664 or above (at most 1.0% of genuine dev clips). *Likely genuine* below 0.642 (at least 99.0% of dev fakes stay above it).

| Clean test clips | Likely synthetic | Uncertain | Likely genuine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Genuine | 1.0% | 0.0% | 99.0% |
| Synthetic | 96.8% | 0.1% | 3.1% |

### What an alert means

At the *likely synthetic* threshold, on clean test audio: false-positive rate 1.0% (0.6% to 1.5%), detection rate 96.8% (94.6% to 98.3%). Share of *likely synthetic* alerts that would be real fakes, if this share of recordings were fake:

| Share fake | clean | g711 | amr-nb | opus | mp3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 in 10 | 91.5% (88.1% to 94.3%) | 94.3% (90.7% to 98.3%) | 75.5% (63.8% to 84.6%) | 26.3% (20.7% to 37.9%) | 90.2% (84.8% to 95.8%) |
| 1 in 100 | 49.6% (40.1% to 60.2%) | 60.0% (46.9% to 84.4%) | 21.9% (13.8% to 33.4%) | 3.1% (2.3% to 5.3%) | 45.6% (33.6% to 67.3%) |
| 1 in 1,000 | 8.9% (6.2% to 13.1%) | 13.0% (8.0% to 34.9%) | 2.7% (1.6% to 4.7%) | 0.3% (0.2% to 0.5%) | 7.7% (4.8% to 16.9%) |

Codec columns use the 3,000-clip test sample (about 1,900 genuine clips each), so their intervals are wider.

## In-domain reference: ASVspoof 2019 LA eval (5,000-clip sample)

Lab-generated speech. AntiDeepfake was trained on ASVspoof 2019, so this is seen
data, a ceiling for comparison rather than a held-out result.

| EER | ROC-AUC | Fakes caught at 1% FPR | Clips |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.9% (1.3% to 2.9%) | 0.998 (0.997 to 0.999) | 96.4% (95.2% to 98.4%) | 4,670 |
